extDescription.message: Updates your progress in Cinepisode while you watch Netflix, and imports your Netflix history into the “Detected” tab.

optionsIntro.message: Generate this token in Cinepisode: Settings › Auto-tracking (Netflix, Plex...) › Generate my token (the same token works for Tautulli and this extension). Paste it below.

coverage.message: Currently supported: Netflix only. An episode is marked as watched at 80% of its length or as soon as the end credits start, a movie at 90%; an autoplayed next episode you stop is not counted.

lastNone.message: Nothing detected yet. An episode counts as watched at 80% or at the end credits, a movie at 90%.

lastInvalidToken.message: Invalid token: generate a new token in Cinepisode and paste it above.

lastNoToken.message: No token saved: $LABEL$ was not sent.

lastNetwork.message: Could not reach Cinepisode (connection?): $LABEL$ was not sent.

lastServerError.message: Cinepisode server error: $LABEL$ was not saved.

lastLegacyNoChange.message: No change for $LABEL$ (not in your list or already up to date).

historyIntro.message: Import your Netflix history (or the Netflix CSV file): detected titles show up in Cinepisode's “Detected” tab, where you choose what gets added or updated. Nothing in your list changes before that.

importCsvHint.message: File: netflix.com › Account › Profile › Viewing activity › “Download all”.

importDone.message: $N$ titles sent ($NEW$ new, $UPD$ more recent). Choose what to add in Cinepisode's “Detected” tab.

importNothing.message: Nothing new since the last import.

importTruncated.message: Very long history: only the 20,000 most recent views were read.

importMetaFailed.message: Some episode numbers could not be read.

importErrToken.message: Invalid token: generate a new one in Cinepisode and paste it above.

importErrNetflixTab.message: Could not open Netflix in this browser.

importErrNetflixAuth.message: Sign in to Netflix in this browser (and pick your profile), then try again.

importErrNetflix.message: Netflix answered unexpectedly. Try again later, or import the CSV file.

importErrCsv.message: Unreadable file: pick NetflixViewingHistory.csv (20 MB max).

importErrLimit.message: Too many detected titles waiting: sort them out in Cinepisode's “Detected” tab.

importErrServer.message: Cinepisode server error. Try again later.
